veranderings.blok: Die Maan maak nie sy eie lig nie
veranderings.voor: maak egter nie sy eie lig soos die Son nie
veranderings.na: maak egter nie soos die Son sy eie lig nie
veranderings.rede: With 'soos die Son' after 'lig' it can be read as 'not its own light like the Sun's light'; placing the comparison before the object is the natural Afrikaans order and removes the ambiguity.
Afrikaans normally uses the plain reflexive 'hom' with 'herhaal'; 'homself' is emphatic and leans on English 'repeats itself'.

vlae.rede: The block heading uses the same 'herhaal homself'; if the body change is kept, the heading should probably match ('Die patroon herhaal hom'), which a script may not be able to apply.
